name: Pop’s Place Bar & Grill
description: Germantown Karaoke is a lively neighborhood spot known for its welcoming atmosphere and regular karaoke nights. The venue offers a fun environment with karaoke events held on Wednesdays and Fridays, featuring friendly staff and a community-oriented vibe. Patrons enjoy affordable drinks, karaoke performances, and a relaxed setting that makes everyone feel at home. The venue's lively nights and friendly crowd make it a favorite for locals seeking entertainment and camaraderie.
